title: Strategies of interfacial chemistry manipulated zinc deposition towards high-energy and long-cycle-life aqueous anode-free zinc metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04525D, Review Article
Tian Wang, Shaocong Tang, Ya Xiao, Weiwei Xiang, Jae Su Yu
This review summarizes the strategies for achieving efficient zinc plating/stripping based on interfacial chemistry manipulation in anode-free zinc metal batteries.
